question.text: In an inelastic collision an electron excites as hydrogen atom from its ground state to a M-shell state. A second electron collides instantaneously with the excited hydrogen atom in the M-State and ionizes it. At least how much energy the second electron transfers to the atom in the M-state?

solution.text:
Hints: \(E_m=-\frac{13.6}{(3)^2}=-1.51\)
Minimum energy required by electron should be \(+1.51 \mathrm{eV}\)
